北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京气温 8℃，体感 2℃，风大天干，记得保暖润燥哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing 8℃, feels like 2℃. Windy and dry, keep warm and hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感 9℃，湿度 79%。添衣防潮，保持好心情！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy, feels like 9℃, humidity 79%. Dress warmly and stay cheerful!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海大雾，视线不佳，路湿湿的。出行慢一点，注意安全！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is very foggy, low visibility. Roads are wet, drive slow and stay safe!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州体感 20℃，阴天湿度高。虽暖也别贪凉，注意防潮哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou feels like 20℃, cloudy and humid. It's warm, but stay dry and avoid catching a cold!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳体感 17℃，湿度 78%。出门记得带伞，保持舒爽！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen feels like 17℃, humidity 78%. Don't forget an umbrella and stay comfortable!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州下雨，体感 9℃。雨天湿冷，带好雨具，小心路滑！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is rainy, feels like 9℃. It's wet and cool, take your umbrella and watch for slippery roads!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京中雨，体感 6℃，湿度 100%。雨势不小，记得防湿防寒！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has moderate rain, feels like 6℃, humidity 100%. Heavy rain, keep dry and warm!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，体感 15℃。天气宜人，出门散散步吧！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 15℃. Pleasant weather, perfect for a walk!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感 7℃，湿度 99%。天冷湿重，小心着凉哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy, feels like 7℃, humidity 99%. Cold and very humid, beware of catching a cold!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 5℃，湿度 100%。湿冷感重，添衣保暖很关键！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy, feels like 5℃, humidity 100%. Cold and damp, layering up is key!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆起雾，视线模糊，湿度 83%。慢行慢走，注意安全哦！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy, low visibility, humidity 83%. Take it slow, pay attention to safety!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨 -9℃，体感 -17℃。寒风刺骨，务必全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin -9℃, feels like -17℃. Biting wind, bundle up thoroughly to stay warm!
哈尔滨.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -17℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳 -2℃，体感 -11℃。风力 3级，防风保暖是重点！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang -2℃, feels like -11℃. Wind at level 3, focus on wind protection and warmth!
沈阳.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阳光正好，体感 11℃。户外活动，享受好天气吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and feels like 11℃. Enjoy the beautiful weather outdoors!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门体感 15℃，阴天湿度高。出门记得带伞，保持好心情！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen feels like 15℃, cloudy and humid. Take an umbrella and keep a good mood!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛体感 2℃，阴天湿冷。添衣保暖，小心着凉感冒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao feels like 2℃, cloudy and damp. Dress warmly, beware of catching a cold!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连体感 -2℃，风力 3级。海风阵阵，防风保暖很重要！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian feels like -2℃, wind at level 3. Sea breeze is strong, windproof and warmth are important!
